{"analysis":"How do the historical completed atoms relate to the inspected current branch/head, and why are their files absent there? Source question IDs: obstacle_observations, current_position. Verbatim passages: “The exact relationship between the historical completed atoms and the inspected current branch/head remains unknown.” “Still uncertain: why the historical product files are absent from the current checkout; whether they exist on an uninspected remote branch or other state; whether live MySQL migration, production data, payment records, and face-recognition identity behavior satisfy the intended flow; and whether the automatic 50% code has ever been applied in a real checkout.”

Do the historical product files exist on an uninspected remote branch or other state? Source question ID: current_position. Verbatim passage: “whether they exist on an uninspected remote branch or other state”.

Which product branch is intended for later implementation? Source question ID: decision_uncertainty. Verbatim passage: “The intended product branch for later implementation is not confirmed beyond the read-only inspection target.”

Does the live MySQL migration satisfy the intended flow? Source question ID: current_position. Verbatim passage: “whether live MySQL migration, production data, payment records, and face-recognition identity behavior satisfy the intended flow”.

Do production payment records and their resolution support the intended prior-paid-purchase flow? Source question IDs: current_position, flow_and_capabilities. Verbatim passages: “whether live MySQL migration, production data, payment records, and face-recognition identity behavior satisfy the intended flow”; “prior purchases can be resolved through search/order/payment evidence in the target integration”; “These are permitted working assumptions for handoff, but the inspected evidence does not prove live wiring, live database content, or production checkout behavior.”

Does the existing face-recognition flow supply successful server-side matches that satisfy the intended same-person flow in live operation? Source question IDs: current_position, flow_and_capabilities. Verbatim passages: “whether live MySQL migration, production data, payment records, and face-recognition identity behavior satisfy the intended flow”; “Assumed dependencies: the existing face-recognition flow supplies successful server-side matches”; “These are permitted working assumptions for handoff, but the inspected evidence does not prove live wiring, live database content, or production checkout behavior.”

Do configured prerequisite rows exist in the database table used by the target integration? Source question ID: flow_and_capabilities. Verbatim passages: “configured prerequisite rows exist in a database table”; “These are permitted working assumptions for handoff, but the inspected evidence does not prove live wiring, live database content, or production checkout behavior.”

Do eligible 50% discount codes already exist for the checkout tour/location? Source question ID: flow_and_capabilities. Verbatim passages: “eligible 50% discount codes already exist for the checkout tour/location”; “These are permitted working assumptions for handoff, but the inspected evidence does not prove live wiring, live database content, or production checkout behavior.”

Does checkout have an existing place where an automatic discount can be applied before payment? Source question ID: flow_and_capabilities. Verbatim passages: “checkout has an existing place where an automatic discount can be applied before payment”; “These are permitted working assumptions for handoff, but the inspected evidence does not prove live wiring, live database content, or production checkout behavior.”

Has the automatic 50% code ever been applied in a real checkout? Source question ID: current_position. Verbatim passage: “whether the automatic 50% code has ever been applied in a real checkout.”

What is the production deployment state of the automatic discount capability? Source question IDs: practical_limits, decision_uncertainty. Verbatim passages: “Remote branches, production deployment state, database contents, and runtime behavior are not verified.” “Production/live data state is genuinely unavailable in the supplied context”.

What is the runtime checkout behavior of the automatic discount capability? Source question ID: practical_limits. Verbatim passage: “Remote branches, production deployment state, database contents, and runtime behavior are not verified.”

Which personnel are available beyond the identified owner-review role? Source question ID: practical_limits. Verbatim passage: “Owner review is the intended handoff stage, but no explicit available-personnel list is supplied.”

What concrete consequences would delay have? Source question ID: practical_limits. Verbatim passage: “No specific new deadline, monetary budget, spending cap, model-call cap, or concrete delay consequence is stated.”"}
